about: The controllers of the cabinet, by the name Linux gives each one.
a, b, x, y, l, r, select, start: the number of the button that does this job in the games.
up_down_swapped: the stick's up and down wires sit on each other's pins.
open, back: the buttons that open and play, and go back, in the menu. Without them the menu uses a and b.
next_letter, previous_letter: buttons that jump to the next or previous initial letter in a game list, and to the next or previous console on the console screen.
favourite: the button that adds a game to Recommended or takes it out, in place of select. Player 2 uses Start for this job.

pi/make_library.py hands the menu's buttons to the menu. On every start it writes a preset with all of them and the hotkeys into retroarch-joypads, in place of RetroPie's preset for the same controller.
GPIO Controller 1 and 2 are the cabinet's two sticks on the Pi's pins (driver mk_arcade_joystick_rpi, map=1,2). hardware/README.md lists the job of every button.
